'''Coruscant Green Park''' was a park area located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], with [[Tree/Legends|trees]] and elegant buildings. By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the park had become endangered, and posters were put up around Coruscant in order to encourage people to take a stand and help protect it.<ref name="Wrong">{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
A torn poster seen on the [[Holobooth/Legends|holobooth]] in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[To Catch a Jedi]]" says:<ref name="Catch">{{TCW|To Catch a Jedi}}</ref>

<poem><big><big><big>PROTE</big></big></big><small>''[ripped off]''</small>
<big>CORU</big><small>''[ripped off]''</small>
<small>''[ripped off]''</small>RE<small>''[ripped off]''</small></poem>

A faded poster seen in [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]' neighborhood in the episode "[[The Wrong Jedi]]" says:<ref name="Wrong" />

<poem>''<small>[faded]</small>''<big><big><big>OTECT</big></big></big>
''<small>[faded]</small>''<big>RUSCANT</big>
''<small>[faded]</small>''REEN PARK</poem>

This article assumes that the third word is supposed to be "[[Color/Legends|green]]."
